args.description: Fat blue butterfly caterpillar that lives in an ant nest, chubby segmented body in pale sky-blue and lavender, a row of small soft bumps on its back, a tiny round head with little dark eyes, short stubby legs, looks cute and harmless. Side view, facing left. Game monster sprite, full body, the whole creature visible, plain transparent background. Bold dark outline, 16-bit JRPG pixel art, same art style as the reference ant monster. Only the monster: no visual effects, no glow, no sparks, no flashes, no particles, no humans, no people, no text.
